# Origin

Snapshot of https://github.com/iohzrd/ratum at `e828545d29b17e5750357214776498da474863fd`
(tag/version **0.1.3**).

This is the DATUM Prime Lazarus runs (`ratum-prime`). Gateways connect here; Prime
tracks shares and sets the coinbase split. It does not build miner templates.

Upstream README: [README.md](README.md). Prime crate: [prime/](prime/).
